title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support Measures II

description.narrative: This Action, aligned with SDGs 5 and 17 aims to strengthen the partnership between the European Union and Ghana by enhancing the awareness, coherence, and effectiveness of EU cooperation, particularly in the framework of the Global Gateway strategy and the Joint Programming Ghana 2021¿2027. It is structured around three interlinked Specific Objectives: (1) strengthening EU strategic communication; (2) supporting EU project cycle management, policy dialogue and public diplomacy; and (3) supporting the role of civil society organisations (CSOs) in national development, especially in areas aligned with Global Gateway and its 360-degree approach.To deliver on these objectives, the Action will implement a range of outputs and activities. Under SO1, it will design and implement strategic communication campaigns that promote EU values, raise awareness of key initiatives, and engage Ghanaian audiences. Under SO2, it will provide technical support for the design, implementation and monitoring and evaluation of EU and Team Europe interventions, facilitate Team Europe coordination, and organise multi-stakeholder policy dialogue and public diplomacy events. Under SO3, it will strengthen CSO capacity and engagement through targeted calls for proposals aligned with Global Gateway and its 360-degree approach.The Action directly supports the implementation of all priority areas of the Joint Programming Ghana 2021¿2027 and its Mid-Term Review, and the Global Gateway Strategy, while also contributing to the EU Delegation¿s Country-Level Implementation Plan (CLIP) of the EU Gender Action Plan III (GAP III), the Youth Action Plan (YAP) of the EU-Ghana Youth Strategy. It also complements Team Europe Initiatives, including the Smart, Green and Digital Recovery in Ghana, and reinforces the EU¿s collective awareness and narrative in the country through a strategic and coherent communication approach.
